description: Evaluate a crypto token for agent interaction using security evidence from GoPlus (primary) and Honeypot.is (complementary, EVM chains only) and return a STRAELO decision that is deterministic for the same observed provider evidence; provider evidence can change between calls and external provider calls may affect latency and availability. There is no tool-specific rate limit. USE WHEN: an agent needs a machine-readable security decision before interacting with a token on Base, Ethereum, BSC, or Solana. DO NOT USE WHEN: the agent needs a guarantee that a token is safe, legitimate, scam-free, or risk-free; provider evidence may be unavailable or incomplete. Returns ALLOW, REVIEW, AVOID, or INCOMPLETE with supporting evidence. Missing or insufficient provider evidence fails closed and never produces ALLOW.

chain.description: Blockchain containing the token. Accepts base, ethereum, bsc, or solana. Input is normalized to lowercase.
chain.title: Chain

token_address.description: Token identifier to evaluate. For base, ethereum, or bsc, provide an EVM contract address (0x followed by 40 hexadecimal characters). For solana, provide the token mint address as a base58 public key.
token_address.title: Token Address

name: token_security_decision

decision.description: Token security decision: ALLOW, REVIEW, AVOID or INCOMPLETE.

evidence.description: Provider evidence that supported the decision.

reasons.description: Short, objective, machine-readable reasons supporting the decision.

title: Token Security Decision
